skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply the concepts, contents, and positions of each component plan within the economic and social development planning system.
Analyze and calculate key indicators in development plans using various models and methods.
Formulate policies for resource allocation, labor force utilization, and fiscal management to support development goals.
Evaluate and critique the logic and methods of planning and policy formulation.
Work effectively in groups to develop and present plans and policies.
Effectively communicate and present plans and policies to stakeholders.
Develop the ability to independently study and apply knowledge to practical situations.
Manage time effectively to complete assignments and prepare for assessments.
Understand and adhere to professional ethics and social responsibility in development planning.
